user.title: 3D-HA-Dashboard
user.description: Adds the 3D dashboard to the sidebar. Without your own house data it shows the built-in demo house. Title, icon and data folder can be changed later under “Configure”.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The 3D dashboard is already set up.

data_description.data_url: Contains model.yaml and textures/. /local/ha-3d-dashboard/ is the folder /config/www/ha-3d-dashboard/. If it is missing, the demo house is shown.
